title: Two insured events share one annual limit
prompt: Losses are positive for losses and negative for gains. VaR at alpha is inf{x: P(loss<=x)>=alpha}; ES is the mean of the worst 1-alpha probability mass, taking only the necessary fraction of any boundary atom. Each annual scenario contains two occurrence losses. Insurance reimburses max(loss-2,0), capped at10 per occurrence, and total reimbursements across the year are capped at12. All amounts are USD million; reimbursement is certain and paid by year-end, with no premium or tax. Return retained annual losses by scenario, expected retained loss and80% ES. Deductible and occurrence cap apply separately to each event before the aggregate cap.

outputs.name: retained_losses
outputs.description: Retained annual losses in scenario order.
